source: PHC workflow specifications v1.1 final synchronized

cases.oracle: valid claim follows employee -> PHC -> accounts -> authority -> payment; audit and status notifications are recorded
authority rejection is terminal; no payment/reopen transition is accepted
approved procurement can be fulfilled after delivery; fulfillment does not adjust inventory
rejected procurement is terminal and cannot be approved later

limitations: The designs were recorded after implementation was visible. Baseline means the first run of these new tests against the current branch.
